structured_requirements.final_statement: All vehicles with gross weight strictly between 1500 kg and 2000 kg shall be equipped with a navigation system.
structuring_notes: Core predicate is 'equip' (system action) → functional_requirement. Ambiguity AMB-01 resolved: replaced 'medium-sized vehicles' with 'vehicles with gross weight strictly between 1500 kg and 2000 kg' per supported interpretation.
